name: Sara Schrodinger
original_name: サラ・シュレディンガー
source:
Sara was trained under grandmother from an early age, and by now she has already earned the title of master. Sara has a bright, energetic and cheerful personality. She seem to be on bad terms with Risthia from the magic science school.

[Translated from [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20020208134318/http://www.web-giga.com/win31/kingdam.htm]the official site[/url].]
